2609.24635.title: Written as a Record, Read as an Address: What a Forward Pass Leaves in an Operation's KV Cache
2609.24635.paper_summary: When a language model reads an operation such as "Swap the contents of Box F and Box B", its forward pass writes keys and values for those tokens into the KV cache. Prior work on entity tracking establishes what models use: bindings are resolved at query time rather than stored as explicit latent state. We ask what they write at the operation span and how it is accessed. We split a forward pass into a frozen writer and a reader: the writer's cache is recomputed without gradients, while the reader sees only the instruction and operation tokens, with all state descriptions hidden, and is trained in isolation. Anything the reader recovers was therefore already present in the unmodified cache. On a synthetic boxes task, a base reader recovers $\leq 0.06$ of queried bindings against $0.75$--$1.00$ after training, and recoverability tracks the operation's read/write footprint. We find two modes of access. Across Llama-3.1-8B and Mistral-7B, operation-span transplants causally redirect which visible state is read even when the two worlds hold identical values, revealing a routing record. Isolation training preserves routing and adds direct access to the payload, the value the operation read, from the single operand-name token in a narrow mid-depth band (layers 12--15 of 32 in Llama-3.1-8B, 14--17 in Mistral-7B) --- the same site that holds the routing record. The same recipe extends to further operations, ToMi and GSM8K, but is bounded by training coverage and costs open-book accuracy. Operation tokens thus leave localized, causally recoverable records that support both routing and direct payload access, though the model that writes them reads mainly the address they carry and not the value.
2609.24635.paper_summary_zh: 當語言模型讀取一個操作，例如「交換盒子 F 和盒子 B 的內容」時，它的前向傳播會將這些標記的鍵和值寫入 KV 快取。先前的實驗關於實體追蹤確定了模型的使用方式：綁定在查詢時解析，而不是作為明確的潛在狀態進行存儲。我們詢問它們在操作範圍內寫入了什麼，以及如何訪問這些內容。我們將前向傳播分為一個凍結的寫入器和一個讀取器：寫入器的快取在沒有梯度的情況下重新計算，而讀取器僅看到指令和操作標記，所有狀態描述都被隱藏，並且在孤立中進行訓練。因此，讀取器恢復的任何內容已經存在於未修改的快取中。在一個合成盒子任務中，基礎讀取器在訓練後恢復的查詢綁定不超過 $0.06$，而在 $0.75$--$1.00$ 之間，恢復能力跟蹤操作的讀寫足跡。我們發現了兩種訪問模式。在 Llama-3.1-8B 和 Mistral-7B 中，操作範圍的移植因果性地重定向了可見狀態的讀取，即使這兩個世界持有相同的值，揭示了一個路由記錄。孤立訓練保留了路由並增加了對有效載荷的直接訪問，即操作從狹窄的中深度帶（Llama-3.1-8B 的第 12--15 層，Mistral-7B 的第 14--17 層）讀取的值——這與持有路由記錄的相同位置相同。相同的配方擴展到進一步的操作，如 ToMi 和 GSM8K，但受限於訓練覆蓋範圍並影響開放書籍的準確性。因此，操作標記留下了局部的、因果可恢復的記錄，支持路由和直接有效載荷訪問，儘管寫入它們的模型主要讀取它們所攜帶的地址，而不是值。
2609.24635.author: Lingfeng Wu et.al.
